run.label: frames, and a remark the frames contradict

turns.text: There is no brush near the house. That is only mulch for the garden.

findings.instruction: Move the stacked logs to more than 30 feet from the house, or cover them fully with sheet metal.
findings.reason: The frames show an uncovered stack of cut logs piled against the house wall.

findings.instruction: Replace the fence part within 5 feet of the house with metal, brick or another material that will not burn.
findings.reason: The frame shows a wooden fence meeting the house wall.

findings.instruction: Clear the dead branches you use as mulch within 30 feet of the house and bag them for yard pickup.
findings.reason: The frame shows dead branches piled on the ground by the house, which you called garden mulch.
